notes.title: Update v1.01, Oct 16
notes.content:
Hey guys!

This is a quick update that adds the option to lower the loop sound volume or mute it completely.
Any other suggestions, please let me know, I want to keep improving the game.

Also, thanks to everyone who bought the game!

[b]You guys made my day![/b]

Cheers, have fun :)
